mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_message (business_id, tenant_id, project_id, conversation_id, user_id, client_message_id, message_text, attachment_refs, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{projectId}, #{conversationId}, #{userId}, #{clientMessageId}, #{text}, #{attachmentRefs}, 'ACCEPTED')
INSERT INTO conversation_event_sequence (tenant_id, conversation_id, next_sequence) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{conversationId}, 2)
mapper.select: SELECT next_sequence FROM conversation_event_sequence WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_event (business_id, tenant_id, project_id, conversation_id, message_id, sequence, event_type, visibility, payload) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{projectId}, #{conversationId}, #{messageId}, #{sequence}, #{eventType}, #{visibility}, #{payload})
INSERT INTO coordinator_dispatch (business_id, tenant_id, project_id, conversation_id, message_id, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{projectId}, #{conversationId}, #{messageId}, 'PENDING')
